versions.content: If development error detection is enabled, the function CanTp_ChangeParameter shall check the validity of function parameters ( param- eter and value ). If the parameter parameter is invalid, the CanTp_ChangePa- rameter function shall raise the development error CanTp.CANTP_E_PARAM_ID . If the value parameter is invalid, the CanTp_ChangeParameter function shall raise the development error CanTp.CANTP_E_PARAM_CONFIG .
